title: Notion Business to self-hosted Docmost
summary: Docmost is the closest open-source thing to a Notion team wiki with real-time editing. It is also newer than Outline.

you_lose: Notion databases, relations and rollups entirely
The maturity that comes from a decade of use
you_gain: Real-time collaborative editing, which Outline does not have
Spaces and permissions built for teams rather than bolted on
AGPL-3.0 and free seats at a tier where Notion charges $20 each

caveats: Docmost is younger than Outline and moves faster. If you want the settled option in this category, read the Outline page.
It has a Notion importer, which is why the estimate is 8 hours rather than more. Verify nested pages after import — that is where imports usually lose things.
Some features are behind an enterprise edition. Check which side of that line you need before migrating.
